ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The picture shows a sheet of grid paper, with a vertical black line in the middle as the folding line. There are several symbols on the left side: there is a right arrow at the top, a gray triangle at the upper left, a downward arrow in the middle, a circle on the left, and a gray triangle near the middle at the bottom. There are also some symbols in corresponding positions on the right side: there is a left arrow at the top, a gray triangle at the upper right, a downward arrow in the middle, a circle on the right, and a gray triangle near the middle at the bottom. Reasoning: Regard the vertical black line as the mirror folding axis, and reflect each symbol on the left side to the right. After reflection, the right arrow at the top of the left side will become a left arrow and fall on the corresponding left arrow on the right side, coinciding. After reflection, the gray triangle at the upper left will fall at the corresponding triangle position at the upper right, with matching shape and direction, coinciding. After reflection, the downward arrow in the middle of the left side is still a downward arrow and falls on the corresponding downward arrow on the right side, coinciding. After reflection, the circle on the left side will go to a position farther to the right and does not coincide with the circle on the right side in the picture. After reflection, although the lower-left triangle reaches the corresponding grid near the lower right, its direction is inconsistent with the triangle drawn on the right side, so it cannot completely coincide. Therefore there are 3 symbols that successfully coincide.

raw_record.question_text: Various symbols are drawn on a piece of paper (see picture). The teacher folds the left side along the vertical line to the right. How many symbols on the left side will be congruent with and overlap a symbol on the right side?

method.method_draft: Treat the vertical black line in the picture as a mirror/fold axis. First list each symbol on the left half of the grid and mentally reflect it to the right: the top right-pointing arrow becomes a left-pointing arrow at the symmetric top position; the upper-left gray triangle reflects to the matching upper-right triangle; the middle downward arrow stays a downward arrow and lands on the matching right-side downward arrow. The left circle would reflect to the far right edge area, not where the right circle is drawn, so it does not overlap. The lower-left triangle lands in the corresponding lower-right cell but its reflected orientation does not match the drawn lower-right triangle, so it does not overlap exactly. Count the successful overlaps: 3.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是一张方格纸，中间有一条竖直黑线作为折叠线。左侧有几个符号：上方有一个向右箭头，左上有一个灰色三角形，中间有一个向下箭头，左边有一个圆，底部靠中间有一个灰色三角形。右侧对应位置也有一些符号：上方有一个向左箭头，右上有一个灰色三角形，中间有一个向下箭头，右边有一个圆，底部靠中间有一个灰色三角形。

推理：把竖直黑线看作镜面折叠轴，将左侧每个符号向右反射。左侧上方的向右箭头反射后会变成向左箭头，并落在右侧对应的向左箭头上，重合。左上灰色三角形反射后会落在右上对应三角形位置，形状和方向匹配，重合。左侧中间的向下箭头反射后仍是向下箭头，并落在右侧对应的向下箭头上，重合。左侧圆反射后会到更靠右的位置，不与图中的右侧圆重合。左下三角形反射后虽然到达右下附近对应格子，但方向与右侧画出的三角形不一致，所以不能完全重合。因此成功重合的符号共有 3 个。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This is the direct mirror-reflection counting route: compare every left-side symbol after folding with the symbol, if any, at its reflected right-side location.
planner_metadata.image_role: Read the fold line, the grid positions, and the shapes/orientations of the symbols on both sides: arrows, triangles, and circles. Use the image to identify which reflected left symbols land on matching right symbols.
planner_metadata.text_role: Read that the left side is folded along the vertical line to the right, and that the requested output is the number of left-side symbols that become congruent with and overlap right-side symbols.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use the rule that folding across a vertical line performs a horizontal reflection. A symbol counts only if its reflected position and reflected orientation coincide with a congruent symbol already drawn on the right side.
